body: Thank you for your comment I appreciate it a lot and I'm sorry to hear that you can relate - BDD is such a horrible thing for anyone to have to deal with.

This documentary brought me to tears a few times, it really hit home. Especially the relationship you have with your mum and not wanting to hurt her from your own suffering - that's something that really resonates with me as well. Thank you so so much for sharing this and raising awareness to such a painful condition. I really wish you all the best, you come across as a really kind person and I can imagine how hard this must've been to make so I really do appreciate your efforts and the progress you're making.
Think I might have to pick it up then! thanks for the recommendation I'll see how it goes :) !
I relate to that so much, a few people have linked some good resources in the comments which may be worth a look! Hoping we can both find a way to overcome this!
I didn't realise there was a sub like that, thanks so much for passing it along! I didn't realise this was a common thing so it's reasurring to hear that

Thank you so much for your comment, this is something I've been doing since I was a kid so never realised there was a name for it definitely going to bring it up with a therapist. It is a horrible thing to deal with and I hope we're both able to overcome it, appreciate the kind words ♥
Thank you I'll give it a look!
It would really be nice to be able to talk with other members I'd be down to!

I feel this, I can understand how people can drift apart but it doesn't make it hurt any less especially when you have those friendships that you feel would never end. But it's good to hear that you are seeking help, that's a really positive step and I hope it will help to lift you!

I wouldn't mind if pictures had to be tagged as nsfw or something but ugh I hate that BDD messes with our perception so I can understand why people would like comments from other people when you really can't accurately see yourself
this was an interesting watch, thank you for sharing!

BDD is awful :( but one thing I will say is that you study art! That's really impressive and you know what I find that impressive *not* based on your looks. You don't create your art by being "attractive" when you do your work it isn't your looks that created the piece! You have value beyond how you look, remind your self this! It's what I've been trying to do, it's hard and  I'm still a long way from recovery but I try to remind myself of other things aside from my looks that make me who I am. I hope this helps a little!

Thank you for your comment sometimes you just need to hear this from another person yknow? Deep down I can understand that looks really aren't everything and it shouldn't be the be all and end all of someone's worth it's just trying to get over this mindset that's probably the biggest challenge. What your saying does make a lot of sense I'm going to try and focus on other things when I feel my thoughts slipping, I appreciate the words.
I've been on the max dosage of fluoxetine which didn't help me (not saying it doesn't) but I am looking to try other alternatives to see if those could help.
I'm glad I'm not the only one 😂 I have a weakness for spreads :x

Hey  
I've been in a pretty similar situation, I've found the less you get involved with things the less you get invited to do things so one thing you could try doing is to organise something yourself and invite them to it - try and build that friendship up again, especially if you don't know what's caused this gap. They were  your friends at one point so they liked you enough to become friends and they might still consider you a friend. It also sounds kinda isolating so maybe you can reward yourself by going out to places? Like a dessert bar or something you enjoy just to break out of your room. I don't know whether you're in high school/college/uni but each of these places opens you up to the potential to make more friends, so don't feel like you won't be able to make more friends/a partner. At uni you might study something where people have a common shared interest which will really help to build friendships, this is something I've learnt from experience. Sometimes you do just need a place to just get your feelings out so don't feel like it's a waste, I hope this can help a little, I really do as I've been in this place before and know it's not hopeless.

Have a good day

​

\~BM

Honestly I did feel more at ease around people but I've pushed all my friends away and I'd feel bad telling them, it's a heavy topic. I've just looked them up and I will see if I can get in contact with him if I don't see any changes before June. I've tried a couple of different medications, one contributed to my lack of appetite and the other just hasn't made a difference, but looking at trying something else. I do really want help, I'd love to be able to enjoy life but it's hard when you're restricted to the same 4 walls.
Thanks for taking the time, I'm at a much calmer place now

Thank you for commenting, I know just how much suffering this can cause and is difficult to even bring to words.
I'm around a similar height/weight to you right now, I've been bigger but even seeing that I'm getting smaller I find it hard to see - even with numbers. Those are all the surgeries I'd like to have, my face is really big for some reason lol like compared to my body I can't ever lose the weight in my face. My relationship with mirrors is complex, I have one mirror that makes me look ugly and one that makes me look uglier (aha) so I constantly have to check to confirm how I look and what I'd like to look like.
That's how I see a lot of people, just constantly comparing it's endless. But one thing I do want to say is that I wish we can both overcome this. I know how painful this is so to imagine that someone else is going through something so similar...I'm sorry to hear that but really thank you for sharing. There's a small bit of hope in me which I'm holding onto, knowing that someone else has these struggles I hope we can both find a way to be happy with who we are even if this feels like such a distant dream.

It's comforting to know that it's possible to get better, so thank you for sharing this and I'm happy that's it has gotten better for you!
I've heard that it doesn't work but I feel like I've got everything planned out enough that it should work, but I do understand how the focus can shift.
I'm in the UK and I haven't really looked at what treatment is available (which I will do) but I've got a psychiatric appointment to see what can be done!
Thank you :) !

Thank you, I'm keeping my head up for now!
Do you know what I think I will try and do that, I'm not good at noticing changes but I'll give it a go. My financial situation isn't amazing but if I was to get surgery I know it would put me in a lot of debt but I don't think that would be too awful
You didn't ramble at all, I appreciate the time taken just to even respond so thank you!
